article.story: CHICAGO -- — Layden Blocker scored 19 points as DePaul beat Maryland-Eastern Shore 83-39 on Tuesday. Blocker also contributed five steals for the Blue Demons (5-0). Koree Cotton scored 12 points, going 4 of 11 (3 for 7 from 3-point range). Magoon Gwath shot 3 of 5 from the field and 5 of 5 from the free-throw line to finish with 11 points, while adding six rebounds and three blocks. Bobby Gardner led the way for the Hawks (1-5) with 13 points and three steals. DePaul took the lead with 18:30 left in the first half and did not trail again. Blocker led his team in scoring with 12 points in the first half to go up 34-16 at the break. DePaul extended its lead to 49-18 during the second half, fueled by a 12-0 scoring run. Cotton scored a team-high nine points in the second half to close out the win. Up next DePaul plays Purdue on the road Tuesday, and Maryland-Eastern Shore hosts Bloomfield on Friday. ------ The Associated Press created this story using technology provided by Data Skrive and data from Sportradar.
